messages:
maria.g: Quick check 3 follow-up on last night's outage. Need owners for customer-facing items: 72h summary, statuspage line, and the RCA-sharing rules.
ryan.k: I can draft the statuspage blurb + a one-paragraph summary. I'll keep it non-technical.
samir.b: I'll draft the RCA sharing policy and a short redaction checklist (what to remove before sharing).
beth: Looping in @olivia.p for legal review of any policy/consent language.
olivia.p: On it. Can review and provide guidance by EOD tomorrow. We should require documented consent for any in-depth technical attachments.
maria.g: Outputs we need: (1) 72-hour customer summary (non-technical), (2) statuspage headline + single-sentence on recurrence, (3) 3-question FAQ for support, (4) clear criteria for full vs redacted RCAs.
ryan.k: Draft statuspage (v0):
"Partial disruption to hosted inference (Mar 24, 2026) 4 some customers experienced service delays following a recent configuration change. Service restored at 03:18 UTC. We will publish a customer summary within 72 hours."
maria.g: Keep cause high-level: "configuration change affecting request handling." Avoid infra terms like cache or hostnames.
ryan.k: Updated accordingly.
samir.b: Proposed sharing rules (short):
- Internal RCA: internal only.
- Redacted customer summary: publish to impacted customers within 72 hours.
- Detailed redacted timeline + mitigations: available within 7 business days.
Redaction checklist: remove PII, internal hostnames, raw IPs, and sensitive security-control details.
olivia.p: Legal agrees with that approach. For deeper technical attachments require a signed consent/NDA and log entries of who received materials.
beth: I'll draft a consent checkbox and an optional enterprise bridge-call opt-in; will coordinate with privacy.
incident-bot: Action created: COMMS-6220 "Publish 72h customer summary"  assignee: maria.g  due: 1797920000
incident-bot: Action created: COMMS-6221 "Statuspage: add recurrence note"  assignee: ryan.k  due: 1797780000
samir.b: Note for tracking: infra flagged this as the 3rd related cache-class tail event in 6 weeks. Public wording should be general: "we are investigating a recurring class of service spikes and will share mitigations when validated."
maria.g: That sentence is fine. Legal ok?
olivia.p: OK. If a customer requests extended details, use the consent flow and maintain an access log.
beth: Will add bridge-call opt-in to consent template and ping support to include it in enterprise replies.
ryan.k: I'll open a PR for the statuspage after legal sign-off and tag support for wording sync.
maria.g: Recap owners: statuspage + recurrence sentence = ryan.k; 72h public summary = maria.g; RCA policy + redaction checklist = samir.b; consent template + bridge opt-in = beth + olivia.p. Samir, link the policy doc to INFRA-772 and add a recurring-incident tag.
samir.b: Will do and file COMMS-6222 for the policy doc.
incident-bot: COMMS-6222 created: "RCA sharing policy & redaction checklist"  assignee: samir.b  due: 1797850000
maria.g: Thanks everyone. I'll post the 72h draft here when ready for a quick review. Reminder: keep customer-facing wording consistent across support, statuspage, and direct replies. End of thread.
